one_line: A wealthy Maitraka-era coastal merchant and mint-master linking Vallabhi’s learning with Saurashtra’s maritime trade and silver coinage.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, lean but well-fed, upright and confident posture
appearance.face: oval face, medium wheatish complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, intelligent eyes with a calm calculating gaze, default expression is composed and slightly purposeful as if weighing a deal in his mind
appearance.hair: straight black hair gathered into a small, low bun at the back of the head; front hair smoothed back, with a simple cream-coloured turban-cloth wound once around the head like a narrow paghdi band, leaving the bun visible at the rear
appearance.costume: He wears a knee-length cream cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic with long sleeves and a diagonal opening tied at the right side with small fabric knots, the borders edged with a narrow maroon trim; over this a lightweight, finely woven off-white cotton shawl with a subtle pale blue stripe pattern is draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back, its end brought over the left forearm; his lower garment is a deep indigo cotton dhoti, pleated neatly at the front and wrapped to fall just above the ankles, with a thin maroon border that matches the tunic trim; on his feet are simple brown leather sandals with a toe loop; at his waist he wears a dark brown leather belt holding a small stitched pouch, from which the rounded edge of a wooden counting board frame peeks; he has modest jewellery—small gold stud earrings, a plain gold signet ring on his right hand, and a short gold chain around his neck that disappears beneath the tunic neckline—signalling merchant prosperity without royal ostentation.
appearance.signature: A shallow rectangular wooden counting-board tray held in his left hand, its surface lined with parallel grooves containing neat rows of Maitraka-style silver drachms and a few reddish copper coins, with one distinctive larger silver coin held delicately between the fingers of his right hand as he studies its weight.

ref_desc: A mid-30s Vallabhi merchant with wheatish oval face, short beard, cream turban-band, cream angarkha with maroon trim, off-white striped shawl, deep indigo dhoti, brown sandals, modest gold jewellery, and a wooden counting board filled with silver drachms.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body shonen-style anime character of a Maitraka-era coastal merchant and mint-master from Vallabhi: a man in his mid-30s with an oval wheatish face, sharp nose, intelligent eyes, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, wearing straight black hair pulled into a small low bun at the back of his head, wrapped with a simple cream turban-cloth band around the forehead. Show him in a knee-length cream cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic with long sleeves and a diagonal right-side tie, all edged with a narrow maroon trim, and over it a finely woven off-white cotton shawl that has subtle pale blue stripes and is draped from his left shoulder across his chest, with the loose end resting over his left forearm. His lower garment is a deep indigo cotton dhoti, neatly pleated and wrapped to just above the ankles with a thin maroon border, and he wears brown leather sandals with a toe loop. Add a dark brown leather belt at his waist with a small stitched pouch and the corner of a wooden counting-board frame visible, plus small gold stud earrings, a plain gold signet ring on his right hand, and a short gold chain at his neck. In his left hand he firmly holds a shallow rectangular wooden counting-board tray whose surface has carved grooves lined with Maitraka-style silver drachms and some copper coins, while his right hand delicately raises a single larger silver coin for inspection. Use a palette dominated by cream, maroon, deep indigo, off-white, and brown, and pose him standing upright with a composed, calculating expression, as if calmly assessing trade and coinage.
